All eight S1FDP legs and the anchor8 adjoint ran rc=0 under --memory=22g, so 22 GiB is SUFFICIENT; the peak RSS (what is NECESSARY) is NOT measured and no artefact on this box records it. Registered at section 14.4 / section 9.1.
